subject: burrowback
disposition: Meshy retexture maps on a byte-identical copy of the installed rigged GLB (assets/creatures/tetherbound/burrowback/models/creature_burrowback_lod0.glb: mesh, UVs, skin, skeleton and clips unchanged), so the F36 pose recipes apply unchanged; flag-off candidate beside it. species.json binding and the installed model are unchanged.
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); CLAUDE.md art rule

meshy_tasks.label: v1_s1
style_image_reference_images: render of installed GLB (3/4 view, existing texture), scratchpad refs/burrowback__installed_34.png
meshy_tasks.verdict: CHOSEN: matte grey stone plates with olive moss between them over warm brown fur, cream badger stripe and charcoal eye bands, plain brown-cream underside with no tiling, ivory claws. Near-zero red.

transfer.uv_check: TEXCOORD_0 unique UV sets identical (17204 values; the script refuses otherwise)
transfer.byte_identity_check: meshes, accessors, skins, nodes, animations, scenes and samplers JSON equal; all 289 non-image bufferViews byte-identical to the installed GLB (the script refuses otherwise)
transfer.maps: base colour (red-clamped, PNG), metallic-roughness (Meshy factors 1.0/1.0) and normal from the retexture GLB embedded images; every other material field kept from the installed material
transfer.red_clamp_note: Tuskroot precedent clamp (sat >0.25, value >0.15): 970 seam/crevice texels (0.023%) recoloured to fur brown; shared red metric 0.0016% before, 0.00% after.

scale_note: Same mesh and runtime fit as the installed burrowback (2.95 m); trainer 1.80 m.
colourway_note: No vivid/shiny/alpha sibling textures were generated; the candidate shows its embedded maps.
follow_up: Judge in engine under the F36 pose recipes before enabling.

license.source: Meshy API existing owner credits; no new purchase

material_note: The installed emissive map (all black) and KHR_materials_specular are kept unchanged from the installed material.

variant_v2.request: Creatures lane code-blind judges (v1 6.23): stones from blown-out white to matte warm grey-brown with darker cracks; let fur show between the plates; olive moss, not yellow.
variant_v2.method: deterministic masked HSV grading of the v1 Meshy retexture base colour (no new Meshy pass)
variant_v2.meshy_tasks: none (0 credits); maps derive from the v1 retexture recorded above
variant_v2.scale: Same mesh, skin, clips and runtime fit as v1 and the installed lod0; only the base-colour image differs.
variant_v2.generation_verdict: Stones now matte warm grey-brown (median albedo 0.45 -> 0.36) with darker crack/edge lines; about 45% of the moss carpet between plates turned to fur brown; remaining moss olive (hue ~70) instead of yellow (52). Face stripes, claws and fur outside the plates unchanged. Not a judge verdict.
